stage: P2 bounded correction, interference and consolidation experiments

training.truth: current value follows last trusted correction; historical event is a distinct future query type
training.source: environment-supplied trust bit; not learned source reasoning
training.update_boundary: outer parameters update only after the full world
training.long_gradient: exact within segments, truncated across segments; fast values persist
training.parent: MLP candidates continue the corresponding randomly initialized P1 lineage

delta_control: normalized-key two-matrix delta update; train from random initialization; equal fast-weight budget approximately
geometry_penalty: implemented option, not evaluated in this round

consolidation.teacher: frozen whole pre-consolidation model with fast memory
consolidation.replay: known experience keys, values for training only
consolidation.publish_gate: reset-fast accuracy >= teacher minus 0.05; unrelated loss <= 0.05; restart identical

publication: do not replace the default individual; retain all seeds and failures
scope: finite symbolic research, no language or artificial-life claim
